name: jira-source
description: Pull tasks from Jira Server/DC or Jira Cloud via the jtr CLI 0.10+, with optional result write-back

configSchema.label: Sample ticket URL
configSchema.help: Any ticket from your Jira instance, e.g. https://tracker.example.com/jira/browse/PROJ-123 — Connect derives the server address and project key from it.

configSchema.label: Deployment
configSchema.help: auto reads it off the server address (*.atlassian.net is Cloud). Pin it if that guess is wrong — a Cloud tenant on your own domain, or a self-hosted instance on a Cloud-shaped one.

configSchema.label: Authentication
configSchema.help: auto picks what the deployment accepts: sso for Server/DC, token for Cloud. sso opens a browser (required for SSO-gated trackers); pat is a Server/DC token, headless; token is a Cloud account email + API token.

configSchema.label: Account email (Cloud)
configSchema.help: Only used when Authentication is token: the Atlassian account the API token belongs to. Ignored on Server/DC.

configSchema.label: Token
configSchema.help: A Server/DC personal access token, or a Cloud API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Unused with sso. Note: behind an SSO gateway a token alone cannot get through — use sso there.

configSchema.label: SSO browser
configSchema.help: Which installed browser the sign-in opens. Change this if Connect reports that no browser was found.

configSchema.label: Transition on completion
configSchema.help: Optional workflow transition or status name (e.g. Done) applied when a run that chose write-back completes successfully. Leave empty to only comment. Transition names are workflow-specific; `jtr transition PROJ-123` lists the valid ones.

configSchema.label: jtr executable
configSchema.help: Command or absolute path to the jtr CLI. The connector runs with PATH+HOME only — if jtr isn't on the server's PATH, use an absolute path (e.g. /Users/you/.local/bin/jtr).

options.label: Yes — comment on the ticket when done
